subject: Anchor safeguard & uplift — renewal proposal and go-live coordination
messages:
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
To: Elaine Chen <elaine@hightide.ai>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 15 Nov 2026 14:12:00 +0000
Subject: Anchor safeguard & uplift — renewal proposal and go-live coordination

Hi Elaine,

Thanks again for the time on Thursday. Attached is a refreshed renewal proposal that aligns with the usage pattern you shared in Q3 and the expansion targets for next year. High-level summary: 

- Price hold: we can hold current list rates through the first 6 months of the new term conditional on signing before 2026-12-31.
- Upsell allowance: 15% credit on incremental committed capacity booked in the first quarter after renewal (applies to the first $120k of net new committed spend).
- True‑up flexibility: one mid‑term true‑up window at month 6 to adjust committed tiers if you outpace the baseline by >35%.

I've attached RDW_HighTide_Renewal_Proposal_v2.pdf and a usage_rollforward_sheet.csv for your finance team. Key asks from our side: a PO or DocuSign signature and a target go‑live for the new capacity by 2027-01-15 so our onboarding cohort can prioritize VPC IP allowlist and capacity reservations.

If it helps, I can put Jordan on a short call to walk procurement through the credit accounting and the DocuSign flow.

Cheers,
Evelyn Hart
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Evelyn Hart | Redwood Inference
Attachment: RDW_HighTide_Renewal_Proposal_v2.pdf (PDF, 128KB)
Attachment: usage_rollforward_sheet.csv (CSV, 24KB)

From: Elaine Chen <elaine@hightide.ai>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
Cc: Hightide Procurement <procurement@hightide.ai>
Date: Tue, 17 Nov 2026 10:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Anchor safeguard & uplift — renewal proposal and go-live coordination

Evelyn — appreciate the clear summary and the docs. A couple quick clarifications before I loop procurement formally: 

1) That 15% credit on incremental committed capacity — can you confirm whether it expires after Q1? We need the credit usable against any Redwood invoice within 12 months, not just immediate offsets.
2) The price hold through first 6 months: does that protect against cadence-based surcharges (e.g., peak-season uplift)?

Procurement (cc'd) — please review the attached proposal and advise on preferred intake (PO vs DocuSign). We will also need the standard security addendum countersigned (SOC2/RSA) — happy to route those once legal confirms scope.

Thanks,
Elaine Chen
Head of Platform & Data | HighTide Analytics

Hi Elaine / Hightide procurement team — Jordan here (sales ops/legal liaison). Quick answers to Evelyn's proposal items and Elaine's questions: 

- Credit expiry: The 15% credit on incremental committed capacity is valid for 12 months from the effective date of the renewed contract and can be applied against any Redwood invoice during that 12‑month window. We'll add exact language to the SOW/term sheet.
- Price hold scope: The 6‑month price hold covers base per‑token pricing and excludes usage-based peak surcharges tied to external cloud pass‑throughs. If you expect high seasonal variability we can add a cap on peak pass‑through to the amendment; suggest we define the cap as +10% of baseline pass‑through costs.

Operational notes: to hit your go‑live target (2027-01-15) we need: signed DocuSign by 2026-12-29, a PO (if PO route) by 2026-12-29, and onboarding answers to the attached onboarding checklist. Evelyn — can you confirm whether your infra team requires a dedicated IP range reservation?

Best,
Jordan Blake
Head, Sales Operations | Redwood Inference

From: Hightide Procurement <procurement@hightide.ai>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 15:10:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Anchor safeguard & uplift — renewal proposal and go-live coordination

Jordan / Evelyn — thanks for the clarity. A few procurement items and proposed redlines: 

- We prefer PO + countersigned SOW (internal policy). Please confirm invoice remit details and whether Redwood can accept net 45 terms for this renewal (we typically run net 45 for platform vendors).
- Proposed redline: convert the 12‑month credit expiry to 18 months for internal budget smoothing. If that can't be accommodated, request a minimum 6‑month notice window for credit expiration.
- Security addendum: our legal team will send a standard addendum including data residency clarity and audit evidence requests. Please confirm Redwood's SOC2 auditor contact and evidence upload window.

We will circulate a PO template and proposed redlines by Monday 2026-11-23.

Procurement Team
HighTide Analytics

From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
To: Hightide Procurement <procurement@hightide.ai>, Elaine Chen <elaine@hightide.ai>

Date: Sun, 22 Nov 2026 09:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Anchor safeguard & uplift — renewal proposal and go-live coordination

Elaine / Procurement — great, thanks for the fast turnaround. Short responses: 

- Net terms: Redwood can accept net 45 for this renewal; finance will include standard remittance details on the DocuSign order form.
- Credit extension: we can extend the incremental capacity credit window to 15 months (compromise between 12 and 18). We'll reflect that in the DocuSign amendment and the SOW.
- SOC2 evidence: Priyom (cc'd) manages audit evidence — Priyom, I'll let you follow up directly with their legal team on uploader access and the auditor contact.

Next steps I propose:
1) Procurement shares PO template (you said by 2026-11-23) — we will return a redlined SOW and a DocuSign envelope same day.
2) Elaine confirms go‑live target; we will reserve the burst capacity in our pool for 2027-01-15 pending signature.
3) Priyom and procurement coordinate SOC2 evidence handover.

If that sequence works I'll send the DocuSign envelope with the updated credit window and net 45 payment term tonight.

Thanks,
Evelyn Hart
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
